beats.anchor: « C'est la messe du foot ! souffle BriBri.
beats.extras: Villagers of all ages just out of Sunday mass: small children of six in white shirts, old men of seventy in jackets with their sleeves rolled up, ladies with fans watching from the side. The baker: a plump white Catalan man in his fifties with a round face, a thick grey moustache and flour dusted up to his elbows. Laia Ferrer, 13: a white Catalan girl with a brown bun, freckles up to her ears, a small white scar on her knee, wearing a flowered summer dress with sneakers, kicking the ball without looking at it. Nil Soler, 13: a tall, very thin white boy with sticking out ears and a serious face, counting passes on his fingers. At the café terrace, a row of old men with tiny cups of black coffee, leaning forward like judges.
beats.outfit: Kaydoudou (13) in his old faded forest green jersey with a white collar and white number 8, black shorts, the fine shaved part on the left of his head, the braided blue and white bracelet on his left wrist. BriBri (12) in the sand gold Costa Daurada shirt with a navy band, green shorts, his red sock on his RIGHT foot and his yellow sock on his LEFT foot in scuffed white sneakers, his soft little afro, the gap between his front teeth showing as he grins.
beats.action: At the edge of the square, BriBri stands on the tips of his toes, one arm flung out pointing at the floury baker in the middle of a circle, mouth wide open in delight. Kaydoudou stands beside him, calm, his eyes already drifting past the circles toward someone further away. In front of them, two circles of players of every age pass the ball on the cobbles under the plane trees, a jacket draped on a bench, another on the fountain's rim.
beats.location: The cobbled square of Vinyamar, a Catalan hill village: eight huge plane trees with mottled bark like world maps, a stone fountain, a church with a square bell tower whose doors stand open, a café terrace with small round tables, green shutters and geraniums on the stone houses.
beats.light: Noon in September, soft dappled light filtering through the plane tree leaves, spots of sun on the cobbles.
beats.camera: Wide shot from slightly above the fountain, the two circles of players in the middle ground, the brothers small at the lower left edge, the bell tower and church doors at the top.
beats.alt: À la sortie de la messe, la place de Vinyamar devient un terrain de rondo, et BriBri montre du doigt le boulanger couvert de farine.

beats.anchor: Le ballon part dans son dos, au millimètre, vers Laia.
beats.extras: Avi Ramon, 79: a tall, thin, slightly stooped white Catalan man with weathered tanned skin, a white moustache trimmed perfectly straight, a beige canvas cap, a white shirt buttoned up to the neck and rope soled canvas espadrilles, perfectly calm, a tiny smile under the moustache. Laia Ferrer, 13: a white Catalan girl with a brown bun and freckles, in a flowered summer dress and sneakers, receiving the ball. The baker, a plump man with flour on his forearms, and old men at the café terrace in the background, some raising their coffee cups.
beats.outfit: Kaydoudou (13) in his old faded forest green jersey with a white collar and white number 8, black shorts, the fine shaved part on the left of his head, the braided blue and white bracelet on his left wrist.
beats.action: In the middle of the rondo circle, Kaydoudou has just leaned too far: all his weight is on his front leg, his arms out, his face caught between surprise and understanding. Behind his back, the ball rolls away along the cobbles, slipped with the inside of the old man's espadrille, straight to Laia's feet. Avi Ramon has barely moved; only his foot has finished its small gesture.
beats.location: The cobbled village square under the plane trees, the stone fountain with a wooden cane leaning against it, the café terrace behind.
beats.light: Noon, dappled sunlight through the leaves, warm spots on the stones.
beats.camera: Dynamic low angle from the cobbles behind the ball, the ball sharp in the foreground rolling toward Laia, Kaydoudou off balance in the middle ground, Avi Ramon calm at the back.
beats.alt: Kaydoudou s'avance d'un pas de trop, et Avi Ramon glisse le ballon dans son dos, au millimètre, vers Laia.

beats.anchor: Un pigeon s'envole de la fontaine.
beats.extras: Avi Ramon, 79: a tall, thin, stooped white Catalan man with weathered tanned skin, a white moustache trimmed straight, a beige canvas cap, a white shirt buttoned to the neck, espadrilles, both brown spotted hands resting on a wooden cane, a faded eight pointed star tattoo on his forearm, smiling with shining eyes. A grey pigeon flapping up from the fountain.
beats.outfit: Kaydoudou (13) in his old faded forest green jersey with a white collar and white number 8, the fine shaved part on the left of his head, the braided blue and white bracelet on his left wrist. BriBri (12) in the sand gold Costa Daurada shirt with a navy band, green shorts, red sock on his RIGHT foot, yellow sock on his LEFT foot, soft little afro, the gap in his front teeth showing in his open mouth.
beats.action: On the stone bench under the biggest plane tree, both brothers have jumped half up at the same moment, mouths open, shouting the name of their home city. A pigeon bursts up from the fountain behind them in a flurry of wings. Avi Ramon, seated between them, leans on his cane and smiles, delighted by their surprise.
beats.location: A stone bench under the largest plane tree of the village square, the fountain and a slice of bright blue sea visible at the end of a narrow street behind.
beats.light: Early afternoon, soft filtered light, a bright spot of sea glittering in the distance.
beats.camera: Medium shot at bench height, the old man in the centre, a brother on each side mid jump, the pigeon flying out of the top corner.
beats.alt: Sur le banc de pierre, les deux frères crient « Douala ? » en même temps, et un pigeon s'envole de la fontaine devant Avi Ramon qui sourit.
